about: The Decision Index release plate: the 12-arm bake of 2026-10-14 (the 11 arms of 2026-10-13 plus Liquid AI's d1-3B; CyberDirk is not on this plate). Three callo lines (Tiel-Coder @{0, 256 early exit}, Sharp-MiniCPM5-2B @{0, 1024}, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (Sharp) @{0, 256 early exit + gate}), Tiel-Coder's plain think 256 and its early exit + gate as rows of the plate's table (not drawn), Clef 27B, Clef-Flash BF16 and d1-3B as single markers; Clef-Flash Q4 is data-only. Paths are relative to the benchmark's root, given to `di.py build` as --root; callo_commits are commits of callo's development history, which the plate names by role (data/builds.json).
title: Clef leads the Decision Index, *thinking narrows the gap*
hardware: Apple M2 Ultra, 64 GB, one request at a time

notes.cap_release: Clef's own release code would refuse 12 of the 13 (“schema requires … tokens before state”) and truncate 1
notes.wide_choice: Callo (wide-choice readout) and Clef both answer up to 255 options, so every arm answers them
notes.board: the 0.3 board's public index for “Cloudflare clef” is 61.71 (full suite, authors' runtime); Clef's card reports 0.2.1 full-suite numbers
notes.timing: Clef 27B ran beside CPU-heavy test runs for its first ~1.5 h (~12:10–13:40 UTC on 2026-10-10) and was not re-timed, so its request time may read high
notes.latency_figures: two Clef arms ran beside CPU-heavy test runs (Clef 27B ~12:10–13:40 UTC, its first ~1.5 h of 3.3 h; Clef-Flash Q4 ~16:00–16:26 UTC, the last half hour of its hour; 2026-10-10); neither was re-timed
notes.reread_fix: an end-of-turn token at the answer slot
notes.run_to_run: Tiel-Coder and Flash-Next are MoE models; on the unified KV cache Callo's llama-server runs, their runs are not bit-reproducible
notes.builds: without early exit their behaviour is byte-identical, but for the readout fix the re-read covers

series.name: tiel
series.label: Tiel-Coder 35B-A3B · Q4_K_XL
series.note: Tiel-Coder think 256 with early exit, and with early exit + gate, ran on the gate build from their own think profile (release-tiel-ee/tiel.think.json, calibrated 2026-10-12 with early exit's convergence probe); the plain think 256 point ran on the first build from release/tiel.think.json.

series.name: sharp-minicpm
series.label: Sharp-MiniCPM5-2B · Q6_K_XL
series.note: Sharp-MiniCPM5-2B no think was re-run 2026-10-11 on the refit build (the first run is superseded and not used); no readout of the re-run walked, so it needed no re-read.

series.name: flashnext-sharp
series.label: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (Sharp)
series.note: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (Sharp): ISTA-DASLab's GSQ-RCO IQ3_XXS GGUF (two shards; the n-gram shard is read lazily from SSD) served with the Sharp chat template v22.5.0; its think 256 point runs early exit (z .95) with the gate, its only reasoning arm on DI.

series.name: clef27b-udq4
series.label: Clef 27B · Q4_K_XL (our quant)
series.note: Clef 27B Q4_K_XL (our quant): its first session stopped at the token-count consistency check (one POP909 row, 6489 server vs 6781 offline tokens) and was re-run; the plate uses the second session.

series.name: clefflash-udq4
series.label: Clef-Flash 9B · Q4_K_XL (our quant)
series.note: Clef-Flash 9B Q4_K_XL (our quant): measured on DI and reported here, not drawn on the plate (it sits on the BF16 reference).

series.name: clefflash-bf16
series.label: Clef-Flash 9B · BF16
series.note: Clef-Flash 9B BF16: Cloudflare's checkpoint converted to GGUF at llama.cpp 1537a0a8 (native Clef path); the reference for every paired CI.

series.name: d1
series.label: d1-3B · Q4_K_M
series.answering: answers each question in its own prompt (the state, then that question)
series.note: d1-3B Q4_K_M: Liquid AI's own GGUF (LiquidAI/d1-3B-GGUF), text only (no mmproj), on llama.cpp 23deec02's native decision endpoint (decision type lfm2-d1) with the Clef arms' server flags; it reads one question per prompt and takes each answer from the next-token logits, at the server's default calibration (the GGUF carries no calibration keys). Its 13 BRIGHT rows are the shared pre-marks, though its own prompts there would fit its context.
